sections.title: Adaptive Behavior
sections.intro_narrative: Adaptive behavior includes the age-appropriate behaviors necessary for an individual to live independently and to function safely and appropriately in daily life. Adaptive behaviors include real life skills such as grooming, dressing, safety, safe food handling, school rules, ability to work, money management, cleaning, making friends, social skills, and personal responsibility.

sections.title: WISC-V Primary Index & Full Scale Scores

scales.title: Externalizing Problems
scales.description: under-control of emotions/behaviors that result in disruptive behaviors, such as aggression, hyperactivity, and conduct problems.

scales.title: Hyperactivity
scales.description: assesses a student's activity levels. Typical hyperactive behaviors may include fidgeting, constant movement, and wandering.

scales.title: Aggression
scales.description: measures a student's tendency to act in a hostile manner. This may include both verbal (threatening others) and physical (hitting/kicking) behaviors.

scales.title: Conduct Problems
scales.description: provides a measure of how often {name} is getting in trouble and is characterized by anti-social behavior and marked impairments in relationships.

scales.title: Internalizing Problems
scales.description: characterized by over-control of emotions/behaviors and not usually marked by acting out behavior. Instead, internalizing behaviors are often described as social withdrawal and/or feelings of nervousness and sadness.

scales.title: Anxiety
scales.description: measures worry, nervousness, and/or unease.

scales.title: Depression
scales.description: measures observable behaviors associated with depression such as loss of interest and energy, verbalizations of sadness, and pervasive sad moods.

scales.title: Somatization
scales.description: assesses complaints of physical ailments or oversensitivity to seemingly normal physical problems.

scales.title: School Problems
scales.description: reflects academic difficulties including problems of motivation, attention, learning, and cognition.

scales.title: Attention Problems
scales.description: measures distractibility and focus.

scales.title: Learning Problems
scales.description: measures aspects related to academic achievement, such as getting poor grades and having trouble keeping up in class.

scales.title: Behavioral Symptoms
scales.description: total score that consists of Hyperactivity, Aggression, Depression, Attention, Atypicality, and Withdrawal.

scales.title: Atypicality
scales.description: measures the tendency to behave in ways that are considered immature, odd, or commonly associated with psychosis.

scales.title: Withdrawal
scales.description: measures the tendency to avoid social interactions or shy away in social situations.

scales.title: Attention Problems
scales.description: measures distractibility and focus.

scales.title: Adaptive Skills
scales.description: overall age-appropriate behaviors necessary to function safely and appropriately in daily life.

scales.title: Adaptability
scales.description: ability to adapt to changes in environment and routine.

scales.title: Social Skills
scales.description: skills necessary for positive social interactions with peers and adults.

scales.title: Leadership
scales.description: skills associated with accomplishing academic, social, or community goals.

scales.title: Daily Living Skills
scales.description: ability to manage personal grooming, hygiene, and daily responsibilities.

scales.title: Functional Communication
scales.description: skills needed to communicate feelings, present ideas, and obtain needed information clearly.

scales.title: Study Skills
scales.description: behaviors that promote academic performance such as reading, organizational skills, and study habits.

scales.title: Global Executive Composite (GEC)
scales.description: provides an overarching summary of executive function across Behavioral, Emotion, and Cognitive Regulation indices.

scales.title: Behavior Regulation Index (BRI)
scales.description: represents {name}'s ability to regulate and monitor behavior effectively, comprising Inhibit and Self-Monitor.

scales.title: Emotion Regulation Index (ERI)
scales.description: represents {name}'s ability to regulate emotional responses and adjust to changing situations, comprising Shift and Emotional Control.

scales.title: Cognitive Regulation Index (CRI)
scales.description: represents {name}'s ability to control and manage cognitive processes and problem-solve effectively, including Working Memory and Plan/Organize.

scales.title: SRS-2 Total Score
scales.description: reflects the overall severity of social deficits associated with the autism spectrum.

scales.title: Social Awareness
scales.description: measures the ability to pick up on social cues and sensory aspects of reciprocal social behavior.

scales.title: Social Cognition
scales.description: measures the ability to interpret social cues once they are picked up.

scales.title: Social Communication
scales.description: includes expressive social communication and the "motoric" aspects of reciprocal social behavior.

scales.title: Social Motivation
scales.description: evaluates the extent to which {name} is generally motivated to engage in social-interpersonal behavior.

scales.title: Restricted Interests and Repetitive Behavior (RRB)
scales.description: measures stereotypical behaviors and highly restricted interests characteristic of ASD.

scales.title: EDDT Total Score
scales.description: provides an overall composite of emotional disturbance characteristics across IDEA criteria.

scales.title: Inability to Build or Maintain Relationships
scales.description: evaluates difficulties establishing and sustaining satisfactory interpersonal relationships with peers and teachers.

scales.title: Inappropriate Behaviors or Feelings
scales.description: assesses inappropriate types of behavior or feelings under normal circumstances.

scales.title: Pervasive Mood / Depression
scales.description: measures a general pervasive mood of unhappiness or depression.

scales.title: Physical Symptoms or Fears
scales.description: evaluates a tendency to develop physical symptoms or fears associated with personal or school problems.

scales.title: MASC-2 Total Score
scales.description: reflects the overall extent and severity of anxiety symptoms.

scales.title: Total Sensory Systems (TOT)
scales.description: synthesizes sensory reactivity and integration across vision, hearing, touch, body awareness, and balance.

scales.title: Cognitive Development
scales.description: assesses sensorimotor development, exploration and manipulation, object relatedness, concept formation, and memory.

scales.title: Language Communication
scales.description: comprises both Receptive and Expressive Communication skills.

scales.title: Receptive Communication
scales.description: measures pre-verbal behaviors, vocabulary development, and verbal comprehension

scales.title: Expressive Communication
scales.description: measures pre-verbal communication, babbling, gesturing, and expressive vocabulary

scales.title: Motor Development
scales.description: evaluates both fine motor manipulation and gross motor movement coordination.

scales.title: Fine Motor
scales.description: assesses prehension, perceptual-motor integration, motor planning, and motor speed

scales.title: Gross Motor
scales.description: assesses limb and torso movement, static positioning, dynamic locomotion, and balance

scales.title: Core Language Score (CLS)
scales.description: quantifies overall language performance and determines the presence or absence of a language disorder.

scales.title: Word Classes
scales.description: evaluates the ability to understand semantic relationships between words

scales.title: Formulated Sentences
scales.description: evaluates the ability to formulate complete, grammatically correct spoken sentences

scales.title: Recalling Sentences
scales.description: evaluates the ability to listen to spoken sentences of increasing length and repeat them verbatim

scales.title: Phonological Awareness Composite (PACS)
scales.description: measures {name}'s awareness of and access to the phonological structure of oral language.

scales.title: Elision
scales.description: measures the ability to say a word and then say what is left after dropping out designated sounds

scales.title: Blending Words
scales.description: measures the ability to combine individual speech sounds to form whole words

scales.title: Phoneme Isolation
scales.description: measures the ability to identify target individual sounds within words

scales.title: General Development Score (GDS)
scales.description: synthesizes overall developmental functioning across all five functional domains.

scales.title: Physical Scale
scales.description: measures large- and small-muscle coordination, strength, stamina, flexibility, and sequential motor skills.

scales.title: Adaptive Behavior Scale
scales.description: evaluates the ability to cope independently with the environment, including eating, dressing, and self-care.

scales.title: Social-Emotional Scale
scales.description: assesses interpersonal abilities, social-emotional competence, and manner of relating to peers and adults.

scales.title: Cognitive Scale
scales.description: measures intellectual abilities and academic prerequisite skills.

scales.title: Communication Scale
scales.description: evaluates expressive and receptive communication skills across spoken, written, and gestural modalities.

scales.title: Full Scale IQ (FSIQ)
scales.description: represents overall general intellectual ability across cognitive domains.

scales.title: Verbal Comprehension Index (VCI)
scales.description: measures crystallized verbal reasoning, word knowledge, and verbal concept formation.

scales.title: Similarities
scales.description: measures verbal abstract reasoning and concept formation

scales.title: Vocabulary
scales.description: measures word knowledge and expressive verbal concept definition

scales.title: Visual Spatial Index (VSI)
scales.description: measures visual-spatial processing, part-whole integration, and nonverbal construction.

scales.title: Block Design
scales.description: measures visual-motor construction and spatial analysis

scales.title: Visual Puzzles
scales.description: measures mental non-motor visual-spatial analysis

scales.title: Fluid Reasoning Index (FRI)
scales.description: measures inductive and quantitative fluid reasoning with novel visual stimuli.

scales.title: Matrix Reasoning
scales.description: measures perceptual fluid reasoning and pattern completion

scales.title: Figure Weights
scales.description: measures quantitative and analogical fluid reasoning

scales.title: Working Memory Index (WMI)
scales.description: measures the ability to register, maintain, and manipulate visual and auditory information in conscious awareness.

scales.title: Digit Span
scales.description: measures auditory short-term and working memory

scales.title: Picture Span
scales.description: measures visual working memory capacity

scales.title: Processing Speed Index (PSI)
scales.description: measures the speed and accuracy of visual identification, decision-making, and graphomotor execution.

scales.title: Coding
scales.description: measures visual-motor processing speed and associative learning

scales.title: Symbol Search
scales.description: measures visual scanning and discrimination speed

scales.title: Adaptive Behavior Composite (ABC)
scales.description: provides an overall summary of adaptive functioning across Communication, Daily Living Skills, and Socialization.

scales.title: Communication Domain
scales.description: evaluates how well {name} listens, understands, speaks, reads, and writes.

scales.title: Receptive Subdomain
scales.description: measures attending, understanding, and following spoken information

scales.title: Expressive Subdomain
scales.description: measures using words and sentences to express oneself verbally

scales.title: Written Subdomain
scales.description: measures functional reading and writing skills

scales.title: Daily Living Skills Domain
scales.description: evaluates practical everyday skills needed to take care of oneself at home, school, and in the community.

scales.title: Personal Subdomain
scales.description: measures self-sufficiency in eating, dressing, hygiene, and health care

scales.title: Domestic Subdomain
scales.description: measures household chores, safety, and food preparation

scales.title: Community Subdomain
scales.description: measures functioning in the world outside the home, including safety, money, and time

scales.title: Socialization Domain
scales.description: evaluates how {name} interacts with others, plays, uses leisure time, and demonstrates coping skills.

scales.title: Interpersonal Relationships Subdomain
scales.description: measures responding and relating to others and friendships

scales.title: Play and Leisure Subdomain
scales.description: measures engaging in play and fun activities with others

scales.title: Coping Skills Subdomain
scales.description: measures behavioral and emotional control in different situations involving others

scales.title: Inability to Learn
scales.description: assesses learning difficulties that cannot be explained by intellectual, sensory, or health factors.

scales.title: Relationship Problems
scales.description: evaluates inability to build or maintain satisfactory interpersonal relationships with peers and teachers.

scales.title: Inappropriate Behavior
scales.description: measures inappropriate types of behavior or feelings under normal circumstances.

scales.title: Unhappiness or Depression
scales.description: assesses a general pervasive mood of unhappiness or depression.

scales.title: Physical Symptoms or Fears
scales.description: measures a tendency to develop physical symptoms or fears associated with personal or school problems.

scales.title: Total Achievement
scales.description: provides an overarching index of academic skill development across reading, writing, and mathematics.

scales.title: Reading Composite
scales.description: combines word reading accuracy and reading comprehension performance.

scales.title: Word Reading
scales.description: measures untimed letter and single-word decoding accuracy

scales.title: Reading Comprehension
scales.description: measures literal and inferential comprehension of passages

scales.title: Qualitative Abnormalities in Reciprocal Social Interaction
scales.description: evaluates emotional sharing, offering and seeking comfort, social smiling, and peer relationships.

scales.title: Qualitative Abnormalities in Communication (Verbal)
scales.description: assesses conversational reciprocity, stereotyped or idiosyncratic speech, and social imitative play.

scales.title: Qualitative Abnormalities in Communication (Nonverbal)
scales.description: assesses pointing to express interest, conventional gestures, and nonverbal social communication.

scales.title: Restricted, Repetitive, and Stereotyped Patterns of Behavior
scales.description: evaluates encompassing preoccupations, adherence to nonfunctional routines, motor mannerisms, and sensory interests.

scales.title: Abnormality of Development Evident at or Before 36 Months
scales.description: documents whether developmental delays or atypical behaviors were present prior to age 3.

scales.title: Social Affect (SA)
scales.description: evaluates verbal and nonverbal social communication and reciprocal social interaction.

scales.title: Restricted and Repetitive Behavior (RRB)
scales.description: evaluates stereotyped speech, mannerisms, and restricted interests.

scales.title: ADOS-2 Overall Total (SA + RRB)
scales.description: combines Social Affect and Restricted/Repetitive Behavior totals against the autism spectrum cutoff.

scales.title: SCQ Total Score
scales.description: evaluates reciprocal social interaction, communication, and repetitive behaviors.

scales.title: Predominantly Inattentive Subtype Symptoms (Items 1-9)
scales.description: counts positive symptom endorsements across the 9 DSM-5 inattentive criteria.

scales.title: Predominantly Hyperactive/Impulsive Subtype Symptoms (Items 10-18)
scales.description: counts positive symptom endorsements across the 9 DSM-5 hyperactive/impulsive criteria.

scales.title: Adult Approval
scales.description: preference for praise, recognition, and positive feedback from teachers and parents

scales.title: Competitive Approval
scales.description: preference for being first, earning top grades, and excelling relative to peers

scales.title: Peer Approval
scales.description: preference for working with classmates, social recognition, and peer acceptance

scales.title: Independent Rewards
scales.description: preference for autonomy, free-choice activities, and working independently

scales.title: Consumable / Tangible Rewards
scales.description: preference for tangible items, tokens, stickers, or edible treats

decision_options.narrative_fragment: Formal academic achievement testing indicates that {examinee_name} is not achieving adequately for {possessive} age or state-approved grade-level standards when provided with learning experiences appropriate for {possessive} age.
Academic assessment indicates that {examinee_name} is currently achieving within grade-level expectations.
Despite participation in scientific, research-based interventions, {examinee_name} has not made sufficient rate of progress to meet age or grade-level standards.
Progress monitoring data indicates that {examinee_name} has responded positively to targeted instructional interventions.
Cognitive and processing evaluations confirm a pattern of strengths and weaknesses in psychological processing that directly impacts academic achievement.

The team verified that {possessive_name} learning difficulties are not primarily the result of visual, hearing, or motor disabilities, intellectual disability, emotional disturbance, cultural factors, environmental or economic disadvantage, or limited English proficiency.
Based on the comprehensive evaluation findings, {examinee_name} meets eligibility criteria for Special Education and related services under the classification of Specific Learning Disability (SLD).
Based on the evaluation findings, {examinee_name} does not currently meet eligibility criteria for Special Education under Specific Learning Disability (SLD).
